Description

Position at Ookla

Job Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Architect to lead architectural development for Ekahau while driving technical alignment and engineering standards across the broader Ookla team. You will define our multi-year technical roadmap, ensuring our systems are scalable, secure and future-proof. You will act as a key advisor to senior leadership and you will  be bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution.

 

Ekahau is part of Ookla's connectivity intelligence portfolio, and this role spans architecture across three complementary product lines: Ekahau, the industry-standard toolkit network engineers use to design, survey, and troubleshoot enterprise Wi-Fi deployments; Speedtest Pulse, which delivers continuous, real-time network performance monitoring intelligence to ISPs and network operators; and Speedtest Certified, the independent certification program that benchmarks and validates network and device performance against Ookla's connectivity standards. Together, these products span desktop, mobile, and cloud, and process performance data at global scale, giving you the opportunity to shape architecture decisions that directly influence how networks and devices are designed, monitored, and certified worldwide.

 

We are looking for world class talent and the applicants should have hands-on skills and attitude, a strong technical background in software and data architectures, and excellent communication skills.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Defining and evolving Ekahau’s multi-year architectural roadmap, ensuring alignment with Ekahau’s business goals and long-term vision.

  • Run architectural governance and reviews to ensure consistent technical standards across engineering teams.

  • Architect complex, high-availability service and set company-wide standards for technical technical excellence and systemic reliability.

  • Act as a bridge between engineering teams, product stakeholders.

  • Elevate the technical bar by mentoring senior engineers and architects.

  • Identify system-wide risks and establish proactive practices to prevent technical debt and systemic failures.

 

Job Requirements

 

We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

 

  • Extensive experience in software development with a focus on architecting full-stack SaaS applications.

  • Expert level fluency in modern backend and cross-platform technologies (Java, Kotlin, Typescript, Postgres) and AWS ecosystem

  • Deep understanding of service-oriented and layered architectures and experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies based on business needs.

  • A collaborative leader who is hand-on, gets things done and can communicate technical plans and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term architectural integrity.

  • 10+ years of relevant software development experience.

  • Background check is required



About 

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

 

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.
